headline: Milwaukee man wrongly accused of threatening the president still facing deportation
summary: Ramón Morales Reyes, a Mexican immigrant living in the U.S. since 1986, was falsely accused by DHS of threatening President Trump. His children, Ana and Antonio, allege that ICE knew he was innocent and framed him to justify his arrest and deportation. The family seeks $5M in damages and continues to fear for their safety due to online harassment. Despite DHS stating he's no longer under investigation, they maintain calls for his deportation.

headline: Lancaster County judge hears challenge to Nebraska K-12, collegiate sports ballot measure
summary: A ballot measure seeking to constitutionally limit K-12 and collegiate sports participation to students' sex at birth is being challenged due to allegedly vague language in its circulated petitions. The measure, Fairness for Girls, aims to permanently establish sex-separate athletics, with male students barred from female-only teams. The dispute focuses on whether the petition's object statement sufficiently conveyed the measure's purpose to prospective signers, with a judge set to decide whether it will appear on the November ballot.

headline: University of Nebraska Medical Center breaks ground on Infectious Diseases Air Transport facility
summary: Nebraska officials broke ground on a $17.4 million infectious diseases air transport training facility at UNMC, to be completed in 2028. The facility, the first of its kind in the U.S., will house biocontainment transport modules and an aircraft fuselage for advanced training of U.S. Air Force members. Officials highlighted UNMC's global health security leadership and pandemic response history, including quarantining cruise ship passengers with hantavirus and treating Ebola patients. The new facility aims to strengthen national defense and public health preparedness.

headline: UVM Health opens new outpatient clinic with leader in suicide care at the helm
summary: Vermont opens new outpatient clinic, Asha Clinic, focusing on suicide care using Brief Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Clinic aims to expand mental health care capacity and reduce suicides in Vermont.

headline: Wind River church leader seeks stalking orders against protesters amid controversy
summary: Following a controversial sermon, protests have occurred weekly for eight weeks outside Foundations For Nations Church on Wind River Reservation. Two protestors were served with stalking orders of protection filed by the church pastor, alleging emotional distress and harassment. The parties are expected to appear in court.
